import json,urllib.request,subprocess,time
OB=subprocess.check_output("grep -oE 'sk-obs1_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' ob_ready.txt | head -1",shell=True,text=True).strip()
def bal():
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/get_user_balance",headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OB}"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=30) as x: return json.load(x)['balance']
def get(p):
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai"+p,headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OB}"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=30) as x: return x.read().decode()[:400]
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: return f"HTTP{e.code}"
b0=bal(); print(f"saldo awal: ${b0}")
# beban berat di model termahal
total=0
for i in range(3):
    b=json.dumps({"model":"openai/gpt-6-astra","messages":[
        {"role":"system","content":"You are Hermes agent. "*150},
        {"role":"user","content":"Tulis 500 kata tentang AI."}],"max_tokens":1200}).encode()
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/v1/chat/completions",data=b,
      headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OB}","Content-Type":"application/json"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=240) as x: d=json.load(x)
    total+=d['usage']['cost']
    print(f"  [{i+1}] prompt={d['usage']['prompt_tokens']} compl={d['usage']['completion_tokens']} cost=${d['usage']['cost']:.6f}")
time.sleep(3)
b1=bal()
print(f"\nsaldo ${b0} -> ${b1} | delta nyata ${b0-b1:.6f} | cost dilaporkan total ${total:.6f}")
print("\n=== transaksi ===")
print("transactions:",get("/transactions"))
print("summary     :",get("/transactions/summary"))
